message: The other night, we had an unexpected blackout, and I was surprisingly calm. I had recently stocked up on a few power banks and rechargeable lanterns, so I grabbed one of each. As I sat in the cozy glow of my lantern, phone charged and snacks at hand, I felt like I had won a small victory over the situation. It turned into a fun evening of board games and storytelling by lantern light. Have you ever turned an unexpected setback into a cozy win?
